summary: Bill Mitchell, a North Carolina executive recruiter, became a hugely influential pro-Trump Twitter pundit in 2016, then promoted QAnon and his own Slow Walker theory and kept a GoFundMe raised for a DC move after relocating to Miami.

evidence.note: Born around 1961 in Germany to a US Army colonel father; exact year uncertain
Watches Trump's 2015 campaign launch and starts tweeting; main span begins here
MIT Media Lab ranks him among the most influential Twitter accounts of the 2016 election
Begins promoting QAnon in late 2017 and calls it harmless despite Q-inspired attacks
2019 GoFundMe for a move to DC; he keeps the money and moves to Miami
Slow Walker, his own knockoff of the QAnon plan narrative
Interview segment on QAnon overlap with neo-Nazis, Proud Boys and the wider far right
Events move from Charlotte to Miami; all action is in the US and online

notes: Titled a crossover with QAnon Anonymous, but it is a BtB-hosted episode built on Robert's own Bill Mitchell write-up (about 50 min), followed by a QAA radio play and an interview with Robert, so tagged deep-dive rather than crossover. Birth year given as roughly 1961. Lifespan end assumed alive.
